script_text: Aquarius, this week the cosmos is rewriting your story in ways you never expected. Early in the week, Mercury in your 11th House squares your ruling planet Uranus, creating sudden disruptions in friendships and group plans through Monday and Tuesday — expect shocking news from a social circle. Wednesday brings relief as Venus sextiles your 11th House, opening a door to a romantic connection through a friend or community event. The mid-week turning point arrives Thursday when the Sun conjuncts Uranus in your 11th House, electrifying your social life and bringing a breakthrough moment in a collective project. Friday through Sunday, Mars trines your 11th House, fueling career momentum and a financial opportunity tied to networking or technology. Your best day is Thursday because the Sun-Uranus conjunction sparks genius-level ideas and unexpected recognition. Your worst day is Tuesday because the Mercury-Uranus square brings miscommunications and emotional friction. This week, say yes to every invitation — your next love or career breakthrough hides inside a social connection. Follow for daily updates.
